Meet ELSA - Your personal AI-powered English tutor.

ELSA Speak is a leading AI-powered language coach that helps professionals and learners speak English with confidence using our essential AI learning tools and custom learning pathways. If you are looking to learn English to help you engage in real-time speaking scenarios to practice job interviews, presentations, meetings, exam preparations, and more. Reinforce your skills with interactive AI-powered games that make learning engaging and effective. Learn English with 8,000+ lessons, and proper pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary.

Download the best AI-powered English learning app today and start your journey to confident English communication!

ELSA SPEAK'S TRUSTED AI LANGUAGE LEARNING APP FEATURES:

THE TOP SOLUTION FOR IMPROVING ENGLISH COMMUNICATION & PRONUNCIATION
- Learn English with a Career-Specific Focus - Speak English and learn vocabulary that is tailored to your field
- Exam Preparation - Prepare for IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, EIKEN, and more with targeted practice to boost fluency with ELSA Speak’s AI English tutor. Available with ELSA Premium (*).

PERSONALIZED LEARNING PATHS FOR ENGLISH PRACTICE
- Customized Language Coach - Start learning English today using ELSA Speak’s AI Conversation coach, Pronunciation coach, and Grammar coach.
- Personalized language learning - Succeed in workplace interviews, giving presentations, interacting in meetings, succeeding at client calls, and having daily conversations.
- AI-driven Conversations & Open-ended Dialogues – AI learning English gives you personalized language learning with realistic conversation practice. 

AI LANGUAGE LEARNING FOR REAL-LIFE ENGLISH CONVERSATION PRACTICE
- English Grammar & Study Vocabulary - AI-driven conversation helps you build a solid foundation in English grammar and study vocabulary. Adaptive AI adjusts to your progress to help you learn what you need.
- English Conversation Practice - Improve English accent and fluency with role-plays, real-life scenarios. Leave language misunderstandings with English conversations behind.
- Speak with an English Accent & Pronunciation Training - Conquer tricky sounds, learn pronunciation with each English practice.
- Learn with Personalized English Study Sets - Save words, phrases, or sentences from lessons or create your own, explore and share sets, and improve your pronunciation with real-time feedback.
- English Accent Training - Learn English with accent choices: American, British, Australian, and more.

INSTANT FEEDBACK & AI COACH FOR ENGLISH CONVERSATIONS
- Superior Quantitative Progress Tracking - Monitor your improvement with data-driven insights.
- Pronunciation & Word Stress Guidance from our AI English Coach - Receive real-time feedback to sound more natural as you speak English.

ENGLISH TUTOR BENEFITS
- Enhanced Global Collaboration: Bridge language gaps with international colleagues or friends.
- Career Potential: Impress clients and colleagues with polished English communication.
- Expand Your Network: Practice English, build relationships, and explore global opportunities. 
- Beyond English Pronunciation: Learn grammar, vocabulary, and communication techniques to succeed academically, personally, or professionally.
---

(*) ELSA PREMIUM
- Access all advanced features such as exam preparation and targeted courses.
- Take your English skills to the next level and start for free with a 7-day trial. Yearly and Monthly Memberships are available.
---

TRUSTED BY ENGLISH LEARNERS AND INDUSTRY EXPERTS
- Honorable Mention in the AI and Data category of Fast Company's 2020 World Changing Ideas Awards
- Top 100 Influencers in State of EdTech Report by EdTech Digest 2020
- Mentioned by TechCrunch, Forbes, Mashable, VentureBeat, Yahoo, Salma Hayek, and more
